description: This file contains unit tests for the GstCapabilities class, which inspects GStreamer element factories, pads, and caps to determine supported media MIME types. It uses Google Test framework and mocks GStreamer wrapper functions to verify the behavior of GstCapabilities in various scenarios involving decoders, parsers, and pad configurations.

classes.name: GListWrapper
classes.description: A helper template class to manage GList of GStreamer element factories or pad templates, simplifying creation and cleanup in tests.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing GstCapabilities behavior with various mock scenarios.

methods.name: expectCapsToMimeMapping
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting string representations of caps to GstCaps objects and unref operations.

methods.name: expectGetFactoryListAndFreeList
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving a list of element factories and freeing the list.

methods.name: expectGetStaticPadTemplates
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving static pad templates from a factory.

methods.name: expectGetStaticCapsAndCapsUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving static caps from a pad template and unref operations.

methods.name: createSinkPadTemplate
methods.description: Creates a static pad template with sink direction.

methods.name: createSrcPadTemplate
methods.description: Creates a static pad template with source direction.
